history.summary: A large 1,733sqft freehold 3BR in D15 East Coast at $1,378 psf, roughly in line with the $1,363 URA median. The eye-catching 10%/yr appreciation rests on just 7 transactions, so it is statistical noise — the real case is a fairly-priced, generously-sized freehold unit in a deep buyer-pool district.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, D15 deep buyer pool, fair PSF (+1% to median) and a comfortable 1,733sqft layout are genuine merits. But the 10%/yr rate is unreliable (only 7 txn) and must be discounted to an RCR-typical ~5%; the 1.22km/15-min walk to Marine Parade MRT is a real liability vs better-connected East Coast peers; and $2.39M sits at the upper edge of the liquid band. Solidly average — a hold, not a standout buy.
red_flags: Appreciation rate built on only 7 txn — not reliable
catalysts: East Coast lifestyle and deep resale demand
